mods.name: 最大 Stackable Items - game limit up to 999 - created by RomaniEs
mods.hint: Gain, use or 转会 an 物品 to fill its 堆叠 to the limit calculated by the game, capped at 999. Limits of 0 or 1 retain 普通 quantity changes. Does not create unowned items. Covers 背包 and 存储. Alternative to the 锻造石/金色 种子-only option: enable only one 物品 mode. Disable this option before deliberately consuming/removing all of a 堆叠.
